Context & provenance

About this edition.

A fascicle of the hadith of Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam b. Nafi' of Homs (d. 222 AH), nearly all of it from Shu'ayb b. Abi Hamza from al-Zuhri. The text is a manuscript transcription with one report to a page.

The edition

  • TextḤadīth of Abū al-Yamān
  • CompilerAbū al-Yamān al-Ḥakam ibn Nāfiʿ (d. 222 AH)
  • EditionFirst, 2004 (a manuscript, published in the free Jawami' al-Kalim program of the Islamic Network website)
  • Kind of workFascicle (juz')
  • Extent69 narrations

How the text is presented

Structure

An undivided fascicle of numbered reports. The title page names the transmitters of the copy and stands before the reports. A few source records hold further unnumbered reports after the numbered one; those are shown together with it, as the source prints them.

English translation

The English is the supplied translation, which follows the source record by record. Notes that the translation attaches to a report appear beneath it, apart from the Arabic and English text.

Arabic text

The Arabic is the text of the source page records, shown as supplied. A report’s printed number stands in its label instead of the text, and page markers are carried over from the source.

Isnad and matn

The English chain and words are divided as the translation gives them. The Arabic is divided at the same point by a fixed rule that does not alter the text; where the rule finds no clean division, the Arabic is shown whole.

Transmitters

Transmission paths list the names the translation gives for each chain, in English only. No transmitter is identified beyond the wording of the source.

Dating

The date shown is the death year of Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam b. Nafi', 222 AH, not a verified date of composition.

The opening and closing material

Title pages, the chain through which the copy was transmitted, and notes that frame the text are kept here. They are not counted among the narrations.

01   Title page and transmission of the copy · p. 1 Read full text ↓

A part containing the hadiths of Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam b. Nafi', in the transmission of the shaykh, the imam, the judge Abu Mansur 'Abd al-Rahim b. Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Shirazi (may God guard him), from the shaykh Abu Bakr Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. Muhammad b. al-Layth al-Shahid (rahimahu Allah). In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

جُزْءٌ فِيهِ أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ رِوَايَةُ الشَّيْخِ الإِمَامِ الْحَاكِمِ أَبِي مَنْصُورٍ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الشِّيرَازِيِّ ، حَرَسَهُ اللَّهُ ، عَنِ الشَّيْخِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ الشَّاهِدِ ، رحمه الله. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
